title: Committee of Supply debate on MCCY and Muslim Affairs, ending with withdrawal of $100 reduction
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head X of the Estimates for the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth, opened by Mr Alex Yam moving a $100 reduction and covering Muslim Affairs and MCCY clarifications.
why_it_matters: The transcript records planned changes to marriage and parenthood support, including expanding Bersamamu and making Project ARIF permanent from June 2026, and to education support through MENDAKI programmes and a Tampines after-school pilot. It also records mosque planning, the SCIS opening in 2028, WMS fundraising, and MCCY measures such as SpexSG taking effect from 1 April and SG Partnerships Fund co-funding. The record does not set out the full practical impact of every measure.

key_points.point: Mr Alex Yam moved to reduce the total sum allocated for Head X of the Estimates by $100.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
key_points.quote: I move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head X of the Estimates be reduced by $100."

key_points.point: Mr Alex Yam later withdrew his amendment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
key_points.quote: I seek leave to withdraw my amendment.

key_points.point: The Acting Minister set out the first of three key pillars as uplifting individuals across all life stages.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: First, we will uplift individuals across all life stages to provide them with opportunities to succeed.

key_points.point: Bersamamu has supported over 36,000 couples since its launch in 2019.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: Since its launch in 2019, Bersamamu has supported over 36,000 couples

key_points.point: The pool of Kadi and Naib Kadi will be increased by about 50%.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: We will increase the pool of Kadi and Naib Kadi by about 50%

key_points.point: Family development officers will be deployed to selected mosques around Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: by deploying family development officers to selected mosques around Singapore.

key_points.point: Project ARIF will become a permanent component under Bersamamu starting from June 2026.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: Starting from June 2026, we will include Project ARIF as a permanent component under the Bersamamu programme.

key_points.point: Some 5,000 couples benefited from the Project ARIF pilot.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: Some 5,000 couples have benefited from the pilot

key_points.point: ReadySetLearn Roadshows will be held in the heartlands from April this year.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: From April this year, parents can look forward to ReadySetLearn (RSL) Roadshows held in the heartlands

key_points.point: Nine in 10 participating pre-schoolers in RSL Maths Explorer entered Primary 1 without requiring Learning Support for Math.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: nine in 10 participating pre-schoolers of this programme entered Primary 1 without requiring Learning Support for Math.

key_points.point: MENDAKI will roll out RSL Language Explorer.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: MENDAKI will expand the efforts and roll out RSL Language Explorer

key_points.point: MENDAKI and MOE, with MSF and MCCY support, have embarked on a pilot programme at selected schools in Tampines for after-school care and support.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: MENDAKI and the Ministry of Education (MOE), with the support of the Ministry of Social and Family Development and MCCY, have embarked on a pilot programme at selected schools at Tampines

key_points.point: MENDAKI has enhanced its tuition programme to the MENDAKI Achievement Programme with two new focus areas.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: MENDAKI has enhanced the programme to the MENDAKI Achievement Programme with two new focus areas.

key_points.point: MENDAKI will expand its mentoring programme to start earlier, from Secondary 1 students.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: MENDAKI will be expanding its mentoring programme to start earlier, from Secondary 1 students.

key_points.point: MENDAKI signed an MOU with NTUC's Employment and Employability Institute to strengthen AI readiness.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: MENDAKI has recently signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with NTUC's Employment and Employability Institute (e2i) to strengthen AI readiness

key_points.point: The Malay/Muslim Youth Taskforce was launched last October.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: Last October, we launched the Malay/Muslim Youth Taskforce

key_points.point: MUIS and the People's Association were asked to support Santunan Emas' efforts.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: I have therefore asked MUIS and the People's Association (PA) to support Santunan Emas' efforts

key_points.point: MUIS considers projected population changes and land development plans in planning for prayer spaces.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: MUIS takes into consideration key factors that contribute to the demand for prayer spaces, such as projected population changes, as well as land development plans

key_points.point: SCIS remains on track to open in 2028.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: SCIS remains on track to open in 2028.

key_points.point: As of February 2026, the WMS has raised over $8.5 million from over 15,400 transactions.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: As of February 2026, the WMS has raised over $8.5 million, with contributions from over 15,400 transactions.

key_points.point: The Malay Heritage Centre will reopen in April this year with Pesta Pecah Panggung – Transcending Boundaries.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: The MHC will reopen in April this year with Pesta Pecah Panggung – Transcending Boundaries

key_points.point: M3 will be expanded and rebranded to M3+.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: We will therefore expand and rebrand M3 to M3+.

key_points.point: The next phase of Project DIAN will launch in April 2026, beginning with an M3+ Networking Session.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: We will launch this exciting next phase in April 2026, beginning with an M3+ Networking Session.

key_points.point: Two cohorts of leaders have completed the TUNAS programme.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: To date, two cohorts of leaders have completed the TUNAS programme.

key_points.point: From 1 April, the company limited by guarantee called SpexSG will be in effect.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: From 1 April, the company limited by guarantee called SpexSG will be in effect.

key_points.point: Efforts have been made to expand Harmony Circle exchanges across different constituencies.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash
key_points.quote: we have been trying to expand that to include exchanges across different constituencies as well.

key_points.point: MCCY and NYC manage Youth Panel recommendations closely to put them through the policy pipeline.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: MCCY and NYC manage this very closely to ensure that the recommendations are then put through the policy pipeline.

key_points.point: Athletes who require athlete life services after ceasing to be carded can step forward.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: In instances where they require athlete life services or other services after they cease being carded, it is not a problem.

key_points.point: The 80% co-funding is for the Sprout tier and the Scale tier under the SG Partnerships Fund.
key_points.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
key_points.quote: the 80% co-funding is for the Sprout tier and the Scale tier.

key_points.point: The SG Culture Pass is currently set at age 18 and above.
key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: right now, we have set it at age 18 and above.

key_points.point: The priority for OBS is the MOE-OBS Challenge scale-up for Secondary 3 students up to 2030.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: our priority for OBS is the MOE-OBS Challenge scale-up for Secondary 3 students up to 2030.

key_points.point: On shared services for NSAs, the assessment is that capacity should be sufficient.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: It is our assessment that we should be okay.

key_points.point: On multi-storey car park repurposing, the consideration is whether the location is suitable and meets specifications.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: it comes down to whether the location is suitable, meets the specifications.

key_points.point: A trial in Woodlands is looking at adjustable weights for outdoor machines.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: there is a trial in Woodlands, if I am not wrong, where we are also looking at adjustable weights for outdoor machines.

key_points.point: MCCY is open to studying and piloting possible programmes after dark.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: we will certainly be very keen to study as well as pilot possible programmes after dark

key_points.point: The new Place-making Project Office under the Inter-agency Task Force serves Kampong Gelam, Little India and Chinatown.
key_points.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
key_points.quote: the new Place-making Project Office that comes under the Inter-agency Task Force does indeed not only serve Kampong Gelam, Little India, but also Chinatown.

key_points.point: The MOE-OBS Challenge will primarily use OBS sites at Pulau Ubin and the coming Coney Island campus.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: yes, it will primarily be OBS' sites, so, they will be Pulau Ubin and also the Coney Island campus that will be coming up.

key_points.point: The Acting Minister said using a ratio of Muslim population to mosques is insufficient because worship patterns, resident concentrations and mosque sizes vary.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: simply using a ratio of Muslim population to mosques is insufficient as worship patterns, resident concentrations and mosque sizes vary across Singapore.

key_points.point: On students in the Middle East, the Ministry works closely with MFA and listens on the ground.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: We work closely with MFA and we also listen on the ground.

key_points.point: A suggestion on AI in SCIS and madrasahs will be brought back to MUIS and shared with the madrasahs.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: I will bring this suggestion back to MUIS and share it with the madrasahs

what_happens_next: Mr Alex Yam withdrew his amendment. The transcript also records planned next steps including Project ARIF becoming permanent from June 2026, the M3+ next phase launching in April 2026, and SCIS opening in 2028.
